title: Owner check: a recipe cooked hands-free
goal: The owner cooks one saved recipe with steps and a timer
acceptance: Copy and paste: `nerv chat "dimmi gli ingredienti per gli special brownie"`, then "vai col primo step", "imposta un timer di 10 minuti", "avanti"; expected: ingredients, steps in order, the timer announced
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner request at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h). Not a measurement.
